meta.title: Settings
meta.description: Change how the site works without waiting for a release.

adminSettings.title: Settings
adminSettings.lead: Change how the site works without waiting for a release. A change applies at once, needs a fresh code from your authenticator app, and goes in the audit log.

denied.title: Only a super admin can open settings
denied.body: Your account doesn't have the super admin role. If a setting needs changing, ask a super admin.

values.amount: {unit, select, minutes {{count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}} hours {{count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}} other {{count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

adminSettings.storedInvalid: The stored value no longer fits this setting, so the default applies. Save a new value to replace it.

form.newAmount: New value, in {unit, select, minutes {minutes} hours {hours} other {days}}

result.saved: Saved. The new value applies now.
result.unchanged: That is already the value, so nothing changed.

errors.wrong_type: {kind, select, boolean {Choose On or Off.} other {Enter a whole number, with no decimals.}}
errors.unknown_setting: This setting no longer exists. Reload the page to see the current list.
errors.forbidden: Only a super admin can change settings.
errors.step_up_required: For safety, a change needs a recent code from your authenticator app. Enter a new code, then save again.
errors.second_factor_required: Enter a code from your authenticator app for this session first, then save again.
errors.enrolment_required: Set up an authenticator app or a passkey first, then save again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again.

staffSessionHours.label: Staff session length
staffSessionHours.description: How long staff stay signed in before they must sign in again. Lowering it also signs out staff whose session is already older.

enabled.label: Sign-in codes by text message
enabled.description: Lets people get sign-in codes by SMS. Keep it off until FOA's messages are registered on the DLT platform.

has80G.label: 80G registration held
has80G.description: Turn on once FOA holds 80G registration, so donors in India get tax receipts.

fcraEnabled.label: Foreign donations (FCRA)
fcraEnabled.description: Turn on once FOA is registered under FCRA and may accept donations from abroad.
